powerdag_result.assumptions: Pass@1 checks expert tool coverage, compatible arguments and dependency ordering. Four real-world feeder models and ten task families; within-family holdout, not field reliability. No run-to-run interval is inferred. Public network-dependent reruns require proprietary data/tools; only3of10families are fully runnable publicly.
